bars.title: Earned speed is kept
bars.statement: After leaving the cap at 2× cruise by ANY means (rope release, shove, well fling, bounce), speed 10 s later is ≥ 99 % of the exit speed with hands off, and ≥ 99 % with forward held. Only the brake spends it.
bars.target: ≥ 99 % of exit speed 10 s later, hands off and forward held
bars.notes: fed only by feel.rope_swing_release — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: Nimble regime
bars.statement: From rest to cruise ≤ 1.5 s. Full 180° velocity reversal ≤ 3.0 s. Turn radius at cruise ≤ 1 screen depth.
bars.target: rest→cruise ≤ 1.5 s; 180° velocity reversal ≤ 3.0 s; turn radius at cruise ≤ 1 screen depth
bars.notes: fed only by flight-reversal / flight-accel-brake — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: The fight stays on screen
bars.statement: At cruise the hull needs ≥ 1.2 s to cross the visible depth. Above the cap the camera opens so that a 2× cruise exit still shows ≥ 2 s of travel.
bars.target: ≥ 1.2 s to cross the visible depth at cruise
bars.notes: fed only by feel.stroke_speed — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: Shove magnitude
bars.statement: The dedicated shove weapon changes a light hostile's velocity by ≥ 30 % of its cruise per hit. The starter gun changes it by ≥ 5 % per hit. A light hostile already at cruise gets faster when shoved along its motion.
bars.target: shove ΔV ≥ 30 % of light-hostile cruise per hit (starter gun ≥ 5 %)
bars.notes: fed only by feel.shove_magnitude — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: Shove displacement
bars.statement: 2 s after a shove-weapon hit, a light hostile is ≥ 1 screen depth off the line it was flying and has not fired.
bars.target: ≥ 1 screen depth off the original line 2 s after the hit
bars.notes: fed only by feel.shove_magnitude — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: Terrain is lethal
bars.statement: A light hostile meeting rock at ≥ 50 % of cruise loses ≥ 60 % of hull and its helm; at ≥ 75 % of cruise it dies. A heavy at the same speed loses ≤ 15 % and keeps its helm.
bars.target: dies at ≥ 75 % cruise closing; ≥ 60 % hull + helm lost at ≥ 50 %; heavy ≤ 15 %
bars.notes: fed only by feel.terrain_slam — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: The rope is a rope
bars.statement: Swinging at 1.5× cruise on a 100 WU line around a heavy anchor stretches the line < 10 % and does not break; releasing at the tangent keeps ≥ 95 % of tangential speed 5 s later.
bars.target: stretch < 10 %; release keeps ≥ 95 % of tangential speed at 5 s
bars.notes: fed only by feel.rope_swing_release — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: Draw-to-fly rips
bars.statement: Mean speed along any hand-drawn stroke ≥ 70 % of cruise; the slowest point ≥ 35 % of cruise. Speed is the pass criterion; track is the constraint.
bars.target: mean stroke speed ≥ 70 % of cruise; slowest point ≥ 35 %
bars.notes: fed only by feel.stroke_speed — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: Impacts answer
bars.statement: Every collision with ΔV ≥ 8 WU/s produces hitstop and camera trauma scaled by exchanged momentum. Collision audio differs by ≥ one octave of pitch and ≥ 12 dB between a scout kissing a rock and a freighter broadsiding a station. A Massline release has a time-domain snap.
bars.target: hitstop + trauma at ΔV ≥ 8 WU/s; audio ≥ 1 octave and ≥ 12 dB apart; release snaps
bars.notes: hitstop, camera trauma and audio are presentation-layer; the headless bench has no instrument for them. the bar is listed here for completeness; this bench cannot measure it.

bars.title: The world reacts
bars.statement: Within 10 s of a kill in a patrol's sight, the patrol makes a visible stay-with-wreck / chase choice. Spilled cargo attracts an NPC within 30 s. Civilians within 300 WU of gunfire change course within 3 s.
bars.target: salvor arrives ≤ 30 s; patrol chooses within 10 s; civilians turn within 3 s
bars.notes: fed only by world.cargo_spill — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: Hitstun law is universal
bars.statement: Helm-loss duration is one function of (ΔV ÷ cruise) and (attacker mass ÷ victim mass) for guns, throws, flings and collisions alike; lights at ≥ 30 % ΔV lose the helm ≥ 1 s; heavies at gun-scale ΔV never do. NPCs recover with real thruster torque, never a hidden gyro.
bars.target: one universal curve; lights ≥ 30 % ΔV stunned ≥ 1 s; heavies at gun-scale ΔV never
bars.notes: fed only by feel.shove_magnitude / feel.terrain_slam / feel.hitstun_curve — not in this evaluation input

bars.title: The 60-second proof
bars.statement: At the reference site, the VISION.md sequence (op working → hauler leaves → pirates intercept → shove spins one → rope-swing-release makes a projectile → collateral → cargo spills → hauler flees → patrol arrives → grab pod → run WANTED) occurs in a deterministic scenario with ≥ 9 of the 11 beats, and in a headed capture at the shipping camera.
bars.target: ≥ 9 of 11 beats in a deterministic scenario plus a headed capture at the shipping camera
bars.notes: needs the PQ-141 60-second proof scenario, which does not exist yet. the bar is listed here for completeness; this bench cannot measure it.

bars.title: The player is never knocked around
bars.statement: In ten minutes of ordinary flight (no rope, no fields, no deliberate ram), contact changes the player's velocity ≤ 2 times per minute and never by more than 10 % of cruise in one event, never changes the player's heading, and never produces visible jitter; a deliberate big event (a slam the player chose, a well the player flew into) may, and it must be legible.
bars.target: ≤ 2 contact knocks per minute; largest ≤ 10 % of cruise; zero heading changes; no visible jitter

values.label: contact knocks per minute on the player, verbs feel.knock_budget (worst of 1 run(s))
largest single knock, fraction of cruise, verbs feel.knock_budget (worst of 1 run(s))
knock events that changed the player's heading (worst of 1 run(s))

bars.notes: visible jitter on the flight bench has no pictures behind it: this evaluation carries no normal-speed Crucible strip whose frames measured jitter, so the clause stays open. the lateral-velocity sign-flip proxy (jitterEvents/jitterMaxSignFlips) is reported beside the clause and never folded into it. the visible-jitter clause and the legible-deliberate-event clause are unbenched unless a headed capture sets jitterMeasured. the largest-knock ceiling is 0.1 of cruise compared with a tolerance of 0.000001: the live rule caps a contact event's cumulative applied delta-V at exactly that fraction, and the bench sums the per-receipt values in a different order, so a run that spends the whole budget lands one ulp above it. The tolerance is float slack, never headroom — at Kestrel cruise that is 0.0002 WU/s.
